title: Administration
description: Organizations, roles, members and quotas for this deployment.
noAccess: You do not have access to any administration section.

localMode.title: Nothing to administer in local mode
localMode.description: This installation runs as a single user with full rights. Connect to a WorkPilot server to manage organizations, roles and members.

passwordReset.sent: A reset link was emailed to {{email}}.
passwordReset.copyLink: No email went: send this link to {{email}} yourself. It works once, until {{expires}}.
passwordReset.failed: The reset link could not be issued

addExisting.email: Add an account that already exists
addExisting.help: For someone who already has an account on this server, in another organization: an invitation refuses their address.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: Give a team its access once: everyone in a group gets its organization role and its role on each project, on top of their own. A group never takes a right away.
groups.name: Name
groups.orgRoleHelp: Added to the role each member already has.
groups.noMembers: Nobody is in this group yet.
groups.projectsHelp: Members get at least this role on the project.
groups.noProjects: This group has no project yet.
groups.removeProject: Take this project away from the group

roles.title: Roles
roles.name: Name
roles.builtInReadOnly: Built-in roles cannot be edited, so an upgrade that adds a permission reaches every organization. Create a custom role to define your own.
roles.selectPrompt: Select a role to see the permissions it grants.

organizations.platformAdminOnly: Only a platform administrator can manage organizations.
organizations.name: Name

audit.filter: Filter by action, user or sign-in

quotas.description: Limits applied to this organization. Leave a field empty for no limit.
quotas.enforceHardStop: Block new runs once the token budget is spent
quotas.hardStopHint: When unchecked, exceeding the budget is reported but runs still start.

usage.description: What the server collects about this organization's members, and how long it keeps it. Never a prompt, code, typed text or file name.

pageActivity.title: Page activity
pageActivity.what: When on, each member's desktop and phone send how many times they opened each page per day (the page's name only: no project, card or text).
pageActivity.inform: Off. Tell the members what is measured and why before turning it on: the change is recorded in the audit log.
pageActivity.since: On since {{date}}. Each change is recorded in the audit log.
pageActivity.erase: Turning it off erases the page counts kept so far when you save.

retention.title: How long data is kept
retention.hint: Empty keeps the server's default. From {{min}} to {{max}} days; older data is erased every hour.
retention.invalid: Enter a whole number of days from {{min}} to {{max}}, or leave it empty.

dashboard.pagesOff: Page activity is off for this organization: nothing is counted.

erase.title: Erase this account
erase.what: Removes the account, its sign-in details and its invitations everywhere. Token totals stay, without a name. This cannot be undone.
erase.done: The account was erased. Its totals now count as an erased account.

report.description: A summary of the organization's usage, sent by email. It carries figures, never a prompt, code, typed text or file name.
report.noSmtp: This server cannot send mail (SMTP is not configured): the report can only be read here.
report.invalidTime: A time as HH:MM and a time zone such as Europe/Paris.
report.weekly: Also the past week's report, each Monday
report.monthly: Also the past month's report, on the first of the month
report.namesHint: Off, the report gives totals only and names nobody.
report.recipientsHint: One address per line, up to {{max}}.
report.defaultRecipients: Left empty, the report goes to the members whose role reads usage: {{list}}.
report.invalidRecipients: Check the addresses: one per line, up to {{max}}.
report.outside: {{address}} is not a member of this organization: the report will leave it.
report.sendNowHint: Sends the last daily report to its recipients now; the scheduled send still goes at its time.

preview.title: Preview
preview.hint: The report as the email carries it.
preview.dormant_one: {{count}} member not seen for a while.
preview.dormant_other: {{count}} members not seen for a while.

budgets.description: Monthly token budgets for a person, a group or a project. Those who read usage get an email at 80 % and at 100 %; a blocking budget refuses new runs once spent, until the next month.
budgets.organizationHint: {{used}} of {{limit}} tokens this month ({{percent}}), set in Quotas.
budgets.noOrganization: No organization budget: it is set in Quotas.
budgets.name: Name
budgets.setHint: A budget set again for the same person, group or project replaces it.
budgets.invalidTokens: A whole number of tokens, from 1 to 1,000,000,000,000.
budgets.blockToggle: Refuse new runs once it is spent
